Our Collection

Rare whiskies, grand cru wines and celebrated spirits — hand-selected from the world's most storied houses, with fresh mazza for the table.

Our House

Curated for the refined palate.

Golden Star began as a single cellar door in 1987 — a quiet room where connoisseurs gathered to taste what could not be found elsewhere.

Today, we remain devoted to the same idea: fewer, better bottles. Each label in our collection is tasted, verified and stored in climate-controlled cellars before it reaches your table.
